title: Alrahuz vs Ufriends IT — Which VTU Platform Is Better for You?
excerpt: Comparing Alrahuz Data and Ufriends IT side by side — pricing, services, NIN/BVN support, API access, and reliability. Find out which Nigerian VTU platform fits your needs.

sections.content: Choosing the right VTU platform in Nigeria can be stressful, especially when there are so many options out there. Two platforms that come up often in discussions are Alrahuz Data and Ufriends IT. Both offer data, airtime, bill payments, and reseller features — but they are not the same. This comparison breaks down the real differences so you can pick the one that actually works for your situation.

Whether you are a student looking for the cheapest data bundle, a reseller trying to maximize profit margins, or someone who needs NIN and BVN services alongside your VTU transactions, this article covers everything you need to know. We compare pricing, services offered, speed, reliability, customer support, and the extra features that set each platform apart.

items.title: Quick Summary — Who Should Use Which?

sections.content: Quick Summary — Who Should Use Which?

If you only need data, airtime, and basic bill payments with good reseller discounts, Alrahuz Data is a solid option. It has been around for a while and has a loyal user base among resellers. However, if you need an all-in-one platform that also handles NIN slip printing, BVN slip generation, NIN/BVN modification, CAC registration, and developer API access — Ufriends IT is the better choice because it covers both VTU and government identity services in one dashboard.
Platform Overview
Alrahuz Data

Alrahuz Data (alrahuzdata.com.ng) is a Nigerian VTU platform focused primarily on airtime and data reselling. It offers data bundles, airtime recharge, electricity bill payment, cable TV subscriptions, exam pins, recharge card printing, bulk SMS, and airtime-to-cash conversion. The platform targets resellers and agents who want to buy data and airtime at wholesale rates and resell at a profit. It has a mobile app on the Play Store and provides API access for developers. Customer support is available via WhatsApp and phone.
Ufriends IT

Ufriends IT (ufriends.com.ng) is a Nigerian VTU and government services platform that combines telecoms with identity verification features. Beyond data, airtime, cable TV, electricity, and exam pins, Ufriends IT also offers NIN slip printing (Regular, Standard, Premium, and VNIN formats), BVN slip generation, BVN and NIN modification (name, date of birth, phone number corrections), BVN retrieval, CAC business registration, and a full Developer API with Node.js and PHP SDKs. The platform uses virtual bank accounts for instant wallet funding and provides multiple account tiers for resellers and agents.
Side-by-Side Feature Comparison
Data and Airtime Pricing

Both platforms offer competitive data and airtime rates. Alrahuz Data is well known for offering very low wholesale data prices, especially on MTN SME and Corporate Gifting plans. Their reseller discounts tend to be aggressive, which is why many data vendors use them as a backend supplier. Ufriends IT also offers wholesale-level pricing across all four networks, with SME data, Gifting data, and Data Awoof options. The difference is not always massive on data pricing — both platforms update their rates frequently based on network provider adjustments.

For airtime, both platforms offer discounts of around 1-3% depending on the network and account tier. The real pricing advantage of Ufriends IT shows up when you factor in the additional services — you can buy data, print your NIN slip, and modify your BVN all from the same wallet without needing multiple platforms.
Government and Identity Services

This is where the biggest difference lies. Alrahuz Data does not offer any government identity services. If you need to print your NIN slip, retrieve your BVN, correct errors on your NIN or BVN, or register a business with CAC, you would need to use a completely separate platform or visit a government office.

Ufriends IT, on the other hand, provides all of these services directly from the dashboard. You can print NIN slips in four formats (Regular, Standard, Premium, and VNIN), generate BVN slips, correct your name, date of birth, or phone number on both NIN and BVN, retrieve a forgotten BVN using your phone number, and submit CAC business registration applications — all without leaving the platform. For Nigerians who frequently need identity documents for bank KYC, SIM registration, or job applications, this is a major convenience advantage.
API and Developer Support

Alrahuz Data offers basic API access for developers who want to integrate VTU services into their own websites or apps. The documentation covers the essential endpoints for data, airtime, and bill payments. Ufriends IT provides a more comprehensive Developer API (v1) with a Sandbox Mode for testing, Node.js and PHP SDKs, and automated webhooks for transaction notifications. If you are building a fintech product or a reseller app that also needs identity verification features, Ufriends IT's API is more complete.
Customer Support and Reliability

Alrahuz Data offers customer support through WhatsApp and phone. Response times vary, but the platform has been running for several years and has built trust among resellers. Failed transactions are usually refunded automatically. Ufriends IT also provides WhatsApp support and an in-dashboard support ticket system. Both platforms aim for instant automated delivery on data and airtime transactions, with manual processing for identity services like NIN/BVN modification and CAC registration.
Pros and Cons
Alrahuz Data

items: ✅ Established platform with years of track record
❌ No NIN/BVN slip or modification services
❌ Limited API documentation compared to competitors
❌ No virtual bank account for instant funding

sections.content: Ufriends IT

items: ✅ NIN and BVN modification (name, DOB, phone)
✅ Full Developer API with SDKs and webhooks
✅ Virtual bank account for instant wallet funding
❌ No dedicated native mobile app (web-based PWA)

sections.content: Final Verdict

If you are a pure data reseller who only needs the cheapest possible wholesale rates and does not care about identity services, Alrahuz Data is a good pick. Their focus on VTU makes them reliable for that specific use case.

However, if you want one platform where you can buy data, print your NIN slip, modify your BVN, register a business, and access a developer API — all from a single wallet — Ufriends IT is the stronger option. The combination of cheap data with government identity services makes it uniquely useful for Nigerians who need both in their daily life or business operations.
Ready to try it? Create a free account on Ufriends IT at ufriends.com.ng and fund your wallet to access all VTU and identity services from one dashboard.
Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: Is Alrahuz Data cheaper than Ufriends IT for data?
items.a: Both platforms offer competitive wholesale data pricing. Depending on the specific network and plan type, one may be slightly cheaper than the other on any given day. The difference is usually small. However, Ufriends IT offers additional value through identity services that Alrahuz does not provide.

items.q: Can I print my NIN slip on Alrahuz?
items.a: No. Alrahuz Data focuses on VTU services only (data, airtime, bills, exam pins). To print your NIN slip, you would need to use a separate platform like Ufriends IT, which supports Regular, Standard, Premium, and VNIN slip formats.

items.q: Which platform is better for resellers?
items.a: It depends on what you resell. If you only resell data and airtime, both work well. If you also want to offer NIN/BVN services to your customers, Ufriends IT is the better option because it gives you access to identity services alongside VTU from one dashboard.

items.q: Does Ufriends IT have a mobile app?
items.a: Ufriends IT is a Progressive Web App (PWA) that works like a native app on both Android and iOS when added to your home screen. There is no separate app store download required. Alrahuz Data has a dedicated Android app on the Google Play Store.

items.q: Can I modify my BVN on either platform?
items.a: Only Ufriends IT offers BVN modification services (change of name, date of birth, or phone number). Alrahuz Data does not provide any identity modification services.

items.q: Which platform has better API support?
items.a: Ufriends IT offers a more comprehensive API with a Sandbox Mode, Node.js and PHP SDKs, and automated webhooks. Alrahuz provides basic API access for VTU services. If you are building a fintech product, Ufriends IT's developer tools are more complete.
